title: NFL owners approve Seahawks' $9.6 billion sale to venture capitalist Vinod Khosla

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL owners approve Seahawks' $9.6 billion sale to venture capitalist Vinod Khosla
sources.description: The Seattle Seahawks' $9.6 billion sale from the estate of Paul Allen to Vinod Khosla was formally approved by the other NFL owners Aug. 26.
